sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Govt. U.P. Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Deo Raj Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant around three years ago and was killed subsequently on 19.05.2023.
The F.S.L. report on record indicates the cause of death as organo phosphorous insecticide poisoning.
The post mortem report on record does not indicate any injury on the body of the deceased.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 15.09.2023.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

entities.text: Jagdish Prasad vs The State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Govt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Keeping in view the cause of death as ascertained in the FSL report coupled with the fact that there is no allegation against the applicant to harass the deceased mentally or physically in relation to the demand of dowry soon before her death and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Jagdish Prasad be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 144 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Neemgaon, District Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Jagdish Prasad vs The State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Govt. ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189738185/
